entries.name: execution-report
entries.description: Rebuild an offline UI exploration or formal execution report from the original stage.
inputs: Midscene observations or verified pytest V5 session

entries.name: plan
entries.description: Prepare a UI automation plan with source-grounded assertions and a validated main Packet.
inputs: Source case or business objective and source material
requires: Identifiable scope, current task identity and observable business oracle
outputs: Plan and Packet 3.0 or clarification items

entries.name: run-catalog
entries.description: Register stages or retrieve the version actually used in an attempt.
inputs: Project and stage, case, attempt identity or stage original
outputs: Stage and attempt catalog, historical script or plan, SQLite and HTML index
